reviews.review: Z-Crew is ready for prime time! Owning Z-Crew since launch I was able to play, see, test and checkout each update as they where released. The game always had serious potential and a great foundation right from the start but seemed as that magic was missing. I was searching for a true high quality twin stick (that wasn't a bullet hell rougelike) on original purchase in December, I was a bit sad with lack of real native controller support (being a Twin Stick Shooter and all) at launch and the game needed a bit of adjusting all around. NOW HELLO JULY UPDATES!!! I got a bit excited when I saw the updates, launched Z-Crew with expectations of messing around and checking progress. Then BAM, all the sudden I am hooked and the magic that was missing has enter the playing field. Updated crafting of weapons and guns DELIVERED! Updated missions with choice of how you want to play, ram through it bang out the main objective or complete side opps explore a bit and rack up the kills DELIVERED! Updated tight controller support DELIVERED! Z-Crew is an example to All Early Access games should be handled. This brings me joy because I'm sick of paying for Early Access games that are actually ALPHA'S at best, then top that off with never finished where websites vanish tweets on the game evaporate and never heard of again! Thank You to Z-Crew's team for a kick butt twin stick
